newsitem.title: GERMANY: Triumph Adler sells Austrian unit.
newsitem.headline: Triumph Adler sells Austrian unit.

text.p: IMM Office Systems GmbH, a unit of German consumer products firm Triumph Adler AG , said on Wednesday it had sold its holding in Austria's Artaker Kopierprodukte to Dutch group Ricoh Europe.
Triumph Adler said in a compulsory announcement that the sale of Artaker had yet to be approved cartel authorities. The company gave no details of the sale price.
Triumph Adler added that Artaker was a general distributor of the Ricoh brand and as such did not fit in with IMM Office Systems' strategy.
